event_switch_race.scenario: Navigating from /app/events/101 to /app/events/102 while request for 102 is pending
event_switch_race.mitigation: Synchronous state reset (event: null, access: null, loading: true) in useEffect before async dispatch; cancellation flag active = false aborts out-of-order 101 resolution

account_switch_race.scenario: User A logs out and User B logs in within the same SPA runtime
account_switch_race.mitigation: Subject string derived from user.id included in useEffect dependency array; stale user cache wiped on auth transition

dashboard_kpi_race.scenario: Rapid switching of selected invitation in DashboardFeature
dashboard_kpi_race.mitigation: Synchronous state reset (selectedInvitation: null, loading: true) inside route change effect
